name: Clean 2D Vector / Infographic
look: Flat geometric shapes, crisp 1–2px strokes, subtle drop shadows, organized grid layouts, high legibility.
text: Smooth directional slide-in (15–20px) paired with opacity fade; clean line-by-line mask reveals; zero chaotic bounce.
graphics: Bars and charts grow smoothly from baseline; icons scale gently (90%→100%); callout lines extend cleanly from anchor dots.
fps_ease: 30 or 60 fps | Smooth Cubic Ease-Out (no overshoot) | Trim Paths, Odometer Number Counters, Subtle Drop Shadows, Masked Text Reveals.
signature: Finance, Healthcare, Education, Law & Civic Rights, Career & Workplace.

name: UI / SaaS / Screen-Style Motion
look: Rounded cards, glassmorphism panels, custom cursors, toggles, notifications, keyboard shortcut keycaps.
text: Monospace or clean sans typing reveals; pill badges popping in; highlighted text marker sweeps across key phrases.
graphics: Interactive cursor glides with click-ripple; UI panels expand with snappy spring; spotlight zoom boxes magnify active areas.
fps_ease: 60 fps | Snappy Spring or Quart Ease-Out (150–250ms) | Cursor Click Ripples, Magnifier Zoom Loupes, Glassmorphism Blur, Keycap Press Scale (92%).
signature: Productivity & Tutorials, Science/Tech/AI, Investing, Business & Startups.

name: Tech / HUD / Node Pipeline
look: Glowing wireframes, grid overlays, dark/indigo canvases, telemetry readouts, interconnected node networks.
text: Digital character scramble/decode reveal; fast vertical wipe with 1-frame flicker; blinking terminal cursors.
graphics: Glowing data dots travel along vector paths; nodes pulse upon connection; 3D/2D wireframe grids rotate slowly.
fps_ease: 30 or 60 fps | Linear Data Flow + Fast Expo-Out Snaps | Path Tracing (Trim Paths), Subtle Chromatic Aberration, Telemetry Counters, Grid Parallax.
signature: Science/Tech/AI, Crypto & Market Data, Fitness Biomechanics.

name: Hand-Drawn / Doodle Sketch
look: Rough brush/pencil strokes, highlighter marker sweeps, notebook/cream paper grain, organic imperfect shapes.
text: Handwritten stroke reveals; highlighter bar sweeps behind keywords; subtle frame-by-frame edge wobble (boil).
graphics: Sketch arrows draw organically toward subject; circles loop around key items; cards drift gently like floating paper.
fps_ease: 12–15 fps (Posterize Time) | Organic / Gentle Elastic | Turbulent Displace (Boil Effect), Posterize Time (12fps), Brush Stroke Reveal, Paper Grain Overlay.
signature: Self-Help, Psychology & Relationships, Parenting, Comedy & Commentary.

name: Papercraft / Mixed-Media Collage
look: Torn paper edges, cutout photos with white sticker borders, tape/stamp overlays, halftone print textures, 2.5D depth.
text: Cutout ransom/label strips slapping onto screen; typewriter stamps; slightly tilted angle drops (±3°).
graphics: Stop-motion stepped entry; layered Z-space camera parallax separating foreground cutouts from background photos.
fps_ease: 8–12 fps | Stepped Stop-Motion + Tactile Overshoot Drop | 2.5D Multi-Plane Camera, Halftone/Film Grain, Drop Shadow Depth, Page Peel / Fold Transitions.
signature: History & Biography, Travel & Culture, Nutrition & Food, Pop Culture.

name: Bold Kinetic Typography
look: Full-screen oversized display fonts, high-contrast color blocks, minimal icons, rhythm- and voice-driven layout.
text: Word-by-word slams synced to vocal stress; rapid scale punches (135%→100%); split-word mask slides.
graphics: Minimal background shapes pulse on beat; micro camera shake (4–6px decay) on heavy impact words; hard cuts.
fps_ease: 30 or 60 fps | High-Velocity Expo-Out (Hard Slam) | Impact Scale Punch, Micro Camera Shake, Motion Blur, Beat-Synced Hard Cuts.
signature: Motivation & Discipline, Strong 3-Second Hooks, Comedy Punchlines.

name: Documentary / Editorial Map & Board
look: Topographic maps, archival newspaper clippings, redacted documents, string connections, broadcast lower-thirds.
text: Yellow/amber highlighter sweeps across document text; crisp lower-third wipes; typewriter date/location stamps.
graphics: Smooth camera pan/zoom across map coordinates; red route/connection lines draw between pins; slow tension push-in.
fps_ease: 24 or 30 fps | Controlled Ease-In-Out & Continuous Slow Creep | 3D Map Camera Fly-Through, Redaction Bar Wipe, Vignette & Film Grain, Highlight Sweep.
signature: Geopolitics, True Crime & Mystery, News & Journalism, Real Estate.
